name: datadog-plugin
description: Use Datadog directly in ChatGPT through your organization's Datadog MCP server. Query logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and more through natural conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Ask questions about your Datadog data in natural conversation: search logs, query metrics, inspect APM traces, check monitors and incidents, and explore dashboards.

Connect to your Datadog site's MCP endpoint:
• US1: https://mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• US3: https://mcp.us3.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• US5: https://mcp.us5.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• EU: https://mcp.datadoghq.eu/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• UK1: https://mcp.uk1.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• AP1: https://mcp.ap1.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt
• AP2: https://mcp.ap2.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp?toolsets=chatgpt

Sign in with your Datadog account.
defaultPrompt: Show me error logs for the "checkout" service from the last hour
Find traces for service "api-gateway" with latency > 500ms
